name: National Mission on Edible Oil- Oil Palm: Custom Hiring Centre cum Harvester Groups
benefit: - **Subsidy for Custom Hiring Centre cum Harvester Groups:** ₹25,00,000/- per unit for equipment, tools, training, contingencies, and maintenance.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. Note: Custom Hiring Center FFBs Harvester Group will be created in each State by Processor/State/Self-Help Groups (SHGs)/Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs)/Registered Society.
